editorial_notes: Public1510 assumes locally finitely many weakly associated base points and a finite-type sheaf; it uses the usual finitely-presented openness theorem as input. This task proves the latter for arbitrary base rings. Neither hypothesis set is merely the same renamed assertion.

The source describes the localized polynomial fibre global dimension as n; the needed bound is at most n, which suffices for the nth syzygy. One may add dummy polynomial variables to avoid the harmless n=0 indexing convention.
